about: Riser-and-whoosh kits for music-intro --style riser. Each layer: id = sfx-cloud catalog ID (or an absolute path), reverse = play it backwards (a whoosh reversed is a riser that peaks at its end), trim_to_peak = stop the sound right on its peak so the beat takes over, db = loudest 100 ms vs the music's loudest 100 ms in its first 2 s, peak_offset = seconds after the hit that the sound's peak lands (0 = on the beat). Rotate kits between videos (--kit 2) so the start never sounds the same twice.

kits.name: cinematic
kits.note: real recordings (Sonniss GDC 2024): reversed wind-gust whoosh as the riser, a low sci-fi pass as the deep whoosh, a fast whoosh on top
